text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph openings like \"First,\" \"Second,\" \"Finally,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay presents ideas in a more structured order with clearer internal progression."},{"evidence":"\"The manager of the company should chose me because...\" and repeated claim statements","quality":"task focus","description":"The essay stays more directly centered on answering the prompt and supporting its main purpose."},{"evidence":"\"I have a good grades\" \"I am interesting about business\" \"I work hard\"","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows somewhat better control of basic sentence formation even though errors remain."},{"evidence":"\"I pay attention in class I do my homework every day\"","quality":"cohesion","description":"The essay links ideas more effectively with repeated supporting points that build on one another."},{"evidence":"\"I always want to learn more every day about my future job\"","quality":"development of ideas","description":"The essay gives more extended explanation of its points rather than mainly listing examples."}]}
